purpose: Runtime evidence for three named P1 foundation or standard-library pages whose primary verification state was not_verified when selected.
scope: Each case is a complete fenced program extracted directly from the named Markdown body by the section heading and fence language. This report covers only those three fenced programs; it is not whole-document, framework, deployment, or external-service verification.

extraction.method: PowerShell reads each Markdown file and selects the first php, java, or rust fenced block following the named validation heading; the selected text is piped unchanged to the container command.

cases.section: 正文提取验证：match 的严格比较与未命中
cases.assertion: The integer arm is selected over the string arm and an unmatched expression without default is caught as UnhandledMatchError.

cases.section: 正文提取验证：组合顺序与短路
cases.assertion: andThen applies twice then increment, compose applies increment then twice, and a false left Predicate prevents the right Predicate from running.

cases.section: 正文提取验证：重新借用与字段析构
cases.stderr: warning: fields `first` and `second` are never read (rustc dead_code warning)
cases.assertion: The original mutable reference remains usable after the call, and the observed drop sequence is Pair::drop then first then second.
